instruction: Choose exactly one allowed action. Use only supplied observations and knowledge. Do not calculate or set emotion.

attributions.cause: The starting squad was strong enough to clear r1_main_1 with all four player units surviving.
alternativeCauses: The herb militia's visible healing may have helped keep the frontline alive.
The weak scattered enemies may have been appropriate for an unequipped team.
attributions.nextTest: Equip the new common loot or challenge r1_main_2 to test whether the squad can continue progressing.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通护手 Lv.3 on 灰鸦战士 directly raised equipped power by 32.
alternativeCauses: No alternative cause is visible because this cycle only changed equipment.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge r1_main_2 or equip the remaining helmet to see whether added power improves progress.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通头盔 Lv.2 on 灰鸦战士 directly increased equipped power from 32 to 55.
alternativeCauses: No other visible change occurred in this cycle.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge r1_main_2 with the 55-power Warrior setup to test whether the preparation supports progression.

attributions.cause: The 55-power team with an upgraded Warrior was sufficient to clear r1_main_2 with all four units surviving.
alternativeCauses: The enemy group may have been easier than the upgraded team could handle.
The unlocked Mage is a new opportunity, but the unlock followed the win rather than causing it.
attributions.nextTest: Compare the current militia team against a Mage swap before pushing r1_main_3.

attributions.cause: The team changed because 烬火法师 was swapped into slot 2 over the prior backline militia.
alternativeCauses: No combat or equipment event occurred; this cycle only changed team composition.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge r1_main_3 to observe whether the Mage improves combat contribution.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通腿甲 Lv.2 on 灰鸦战士 increased equipped power from 55 to 82.
alternativeCauses: No other visible action occurred in this cycle.
attributions.nextTest: Equip the remaining boots or challenge r1_main_3 to test the upgraded Mage team.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通靴子 Lv.4 on 灰鸦战士 increased equipped power from 82 to 108.
alternativeCauses: No other visible action occurred in this cycle.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge r1_main_3 with the Mage team and 108 equipped power.

attributions.cause: The 108-power team with Mage backline damage cleared r1_main_3 with all four units surviving.
alternativeCauses: The Mage visibly killed enemies during the fight, suggesting the team swap helped.
The Warrior gear stack may still be the main stability source.
attributions.nextTest: Equip the rare leg armor or test the newly unlocked route before pushing deeper.

attributions.cause: Equipping 稀有腿甲 Lv.4 replaced older common leg armor and raised equipped power from 108 to 119.
alternativeCauses: The gain was smaller because it replaced an existing leg item rather than filling an empty slot.
attributions.nextTest: Use the upgraded team on the optional prison rescue or r1_main_4.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通靴子 Lv.3 on 拒马民兵 filled an empty slot and raised equipped power from 119 to 149.
alternativeCauses: No other visible action occurred during this cycle.
attributions.nextTest: Equip the remaining leg armor on an empty-slot frontliner or attempt the prison rescue.

attributions.cause: Equipping 普通腿甲 Lv.2 on 拒马民兵 filled another empty slot and raised equipped power from 149 to 175.
alternativeCauses: No other visible action occurred during this cycle.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge the prison rescue or r1_main_4 with the fully equipped front line.

attributions.cause: The 175-power team cleared r1_prison with all four units surviving, which enabled the rescue payoff.
alternativeCauses: Visible heals from 草药民兵 and 拒马民兵 helped sustain the frontline.
The Warrior and Mage both visibly killed enemies during the fight.
attributions.nextTest: Evaluate whether the rescued Ranger should replace a militia before returning to Main 4.
